statement.text:
Let ω(G) denote the set of element orders of a finite group G, and h(G) the
number of pairwise nonisomorphic finite groups H with ω(H) = ω(G). Find h(L),
where
   a) L is the symmetric group of degree 10;
   b) L is the automorphism group of the simple sporadic Janko group J2 ;
   c) P SL(2, q) < L ⩽ Aut(P SL(2, q)).
See the current status in (M. A. Grechkoseeva, V. D. Mazurov, W. J. Shi, A. V. Vasil’ev,
N. Yang, Commun. Math. Stat., 11, no. 2 (2023), 169–194; Subsection 4.2).
                                                         M. A. Grechkoseeva, A. V. Vasil’ev
